def move(board, direction):
    out=board[:];p=out.index(0);r,c=divmod(p,3)
    dr,dc={'up':(-1,0),'down':(1,0),'left':(0,-1),'right':(0,1)}[direction]
    nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
    if 0<=nr<3 and 0<=nc<3:
        q=nr*3+nc;out[p],out[q]=out[q],out[p]
    return out

steps.text: Copy board into out so the input is not changed. Set p to out.index(0). Set (r, c) to divmod(p, 3).
Set (nr, nc) to (r + dr, c + dc).
Check whether 0 is at most nr and is less than 3 and 0 is at most nc and is less than 3.
Set q to nr * 3 + nc. Set (out[p], out[q]) to (out[q], out[p]).
